bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Bedroom count the guest asked for.

city.title: City
city.description: City the guest was asking about.

consent.title: Consent
consent.description: True only after the guest explicitly agrees to follow-up.

email.title: Email
email.description: Guest's email address, if they gave one.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Given name. For a full name, put every word except the last one here. JoJo Test means JoJo. Leave empty only when the guest gave a single name.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Family name only, the last word of the guest's name. JoJo Test means Test. Do not put the full name here.

max_rent.title: Maximum Rent
max_rent.description: Maximum monthly rent the guest asked for.

messaging_session_id.title: Messaging Session Id
messaging_session_id.description: Current messaging session. Filled from the channel. Do not ask the guest.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: Short note about what the guest wants.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Guest's phone number, if they gave one.
